files.description: Club members, one per row (240 rows): member_id (whole number), full_name (first and last name; many names have accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent), home_city (city name, several with accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent; about 3% of cells are empty and about 3% hold "-" for an unknown city), fee (yearly fee, two decimals).

task_text: Tidy the members file: in every text column remove the spaces around the values and write each word with a leading capital letter (for example 'ZÜRICH  ' becomes 'Zürich'). Then, for each home city, count the members and add up their fees. Leave out members whose city is empty or '-'. `result` should be a table with the columns home_city, members and total_fee, one row per city.
intended_computation: Read members.csv, strip surrounding spaces and title-case the text columns (home_city is the one that matters), drop rows whose city is missing or '-', then group by the tidied city and report the number of members and the sum of fee per city: 8 cities, 226 members in total.

acceptable_variants.notes: fee totals may be rounded to 2 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the text columns are no longer detected by the type test, so city names stay untidied and split into many groups

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
